content: Event schema best practice: every event carries eventId, timestamp, type, schemaVersion, correlationId/causationId; event names are past-tense facts (e.g. TaskCompleted not CompleteTask); commands (imperative, single owner) are distinct from events (facts already true, many subscribers). Versioning: only add optional fields, never remove/rename/retype existing fields; start with JSON Schema for velocity, migrate to Avro/Protobuf only if throughput demands it. Directly informs the packages/event-schema design for PixelFirm.
